name: project-team-grid
description: Resource-centric team timeline for project managers, one group per project. Renders every project the current PM is responsible for, stacked top-to-bottom: each project gets a labeled group with its team (derived from allocations), their allocation/absence bars (allocations read-only), and a synthetic 'Be om ressurser' row for ad-hoc staffing requests (work type, trade skills, count, comment).
